en: A black‑and‑white riverside view of a European city. In the foreground a long, low river steamer with the name "PIRNA" on its side travels along a wide river. Along the opposite bank stands a row of multi‑storey 19th‑century townhouses and small buildings. Behind them rises a wooded hill, sparsely covered with leafless trees, and on its summit is a small church or chapel with a steep spire and several associated buildings. The sky is blank and light, giving the photograph a vintage appearance typical of old postcards.
